items.claim: Chanel Dyer holds height and reach advantages over Elise Reed.
items.quote: She's got the height advantage, two, three inches taller, two inch reach advantage

items.claim: Chanel Dyer is the harder hitter and better athlete in this matchup.
items.quote: I feel like she's the bigger girl out there, the harder hitter, the better athlete

items.claim: Elise Reed has never lost by decision in her career.
items.quote: Reed has never lost by decision.

items.claim: Elise Reed keeps her hands low, opening her up to potential head kicks.
items.quote: Elise Reed keeps those hands so low. Might see one of the most brutal women's headkick KOs of all time this week.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has two professional losses by submission.
items.quote: You look at Jackson McVeyy's pro losses two by submission.

items.quote: Wes Schultz a submission ace a guy that doesn't quit on himself.
